metadata.title: A linear-range application of Lev sumset bounds to forbidden subset sums
metadata.description:
Anonymous, unreviewed mathematical preprint and reproducibility package. The manuscript studies the application of existing Lev sumset estimates to the least-non-divisor forbidden subset-sum problem, giving the range factor q-1 and the q=4, c=2/3 congruence-class limit.

The bounded-basis lemma is a direct corollary of Lev (1997), Theorem 1-prime; the good-core, distinctification and central-interval framework is prior work. No first-ever structure theorem, bridge or formalization claim is made. The package contains an independent Lean reimplementation of the finite distinctification bridge and arithmetic steps, not a complete formalization of either main theorem.

External peer review has not occurred. Novelty and priority are not certified: one relevant Huicochea (2018) main theorem and current forum discussion remain unread, and the cited full-text read-set is bounded. These limitations and the AI-assisted preparation are disclosed in the reviewer package. The anonymous manuscript does not hide the ownership of the hosting account.
